novelty_signal: This remains the only bridge with a credible novelty moat, but only in the narrow H1 form: a reusable cross-family obstruction dictionary rather than a better one-vertex-extension workflow.
validation_plan: Build frontier_parent, extension_case, and failure_witness artifacts for at least 3 non-isomorphic parent families and measure orbit-distinct core recurrence.
Promote only if the top canonical cores cover at least 30 percent of failed 42 -> 43 extensions before any stronger claim is made.
risk: If the atlas mainly re-describes Exoo-line failures or cannot be reconstructed from local artifacts, it collapses into Lehavi/Ge overlap with no durable moat.

novelty_signal: Verifier feedback makes this mandatory: without symmetry-stable identities, recurrence, transfer, and proof reuse are not interpretable.
validation_plan: Implement a canonical core encoding with automorphism-aware normalization and attachment labels.
Run a raw-versus-canonical ablation and require at least 2x core compression with unchanged witness coverage and stable ids under encoding permutations.
risk: If equivalent witnesses do not collapse to the same canonical id, every recurrence and transfer claim is polluted by representation noise.

novelty_signal: Anti-Exoo holdout is the strongest falsifier in the packet, so transfer is the cleanest separator between structural Ramsey objects and lineage memorization.
validation_plan: Freeze family labels before tuning and hold out the most non-Exoo-like parent family.
Demote immediately if held-out coverage falls below 50 percent of training-side coverage or if support collapses to one lineage.
risk: If the recurring cores do not transfer across parent families, H1 is not materially distinct from prior one-vertex-extension checking.

novelty_signal: The falsifier and benchmark reports both make witness safety non-negotiable; any usable pruning object must survive the known 42/43 witnesses.
validation_plan: Build a witness-survival matrix with rows for known 42- and 43-vertex witnesses and columns for candidate filters.
Retain only filters with zero witness deletions and a measurable reduction in failure cases under matched-compute on/off ablations.
risk: One witness kill invalidates the bridge regardless of coverage gains or proof-byte wins.

novelty_signal: Benchmark feedback says neutral/random and non-Exoo provenance controls are still missing, so this audit is now part of the main validation spine rather than a cosmetic check.
validation_plan: Compare atlas statistics under Exoo-like parents, asymmetric perturbative parents, and alternative provenance families.
Demote if one family contributes more than 50 percent of recurring-core support or if dominant cores vanish outside Exoo-like seeds.
risk: Without provenance diversity, every positive H1 signal can be dismissed as Exoo-line memorization.

risk: This bridge is one metric slip away from becoming Exoo-style search with a fancier energy function.
